title: Lateral load tests.
officialText:
Where testing is required, lateral load tests shall be performed in accordance with ASTM D 3966. A
minimum of two piles shall be tested for every area of similar subsurface conditions. For conditions where multiple pile types or
capacities are used, refer to Section 1808.2.5.
